sql: SELECT h.team_name, a.team_name FROM matches m JOIN teams h ON m.home_team_id=h.team_id JOIN teams a ON m.away_team_id=a.team_id WHERE m.match_id=80

WITH t AS (SELECT tm.team_name, COUNT(*) c FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON g.match_id=m.match_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.team_id=g.scoring_team_id WHERE m.went_to_extra_time=1 GROUP BY tm.team_name) SELECT team_name, c FROM t WHERE c=(SELECT MAX(c) FROM t) ORDER BY team_name
SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(g.goal_id) AS REAL)/COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id),2) FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id=s.stadium_id LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.match_id=m.match_id WHERE s.country='USA'
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(went_to_penalties=1)/COUNT(*),1) FROM matches WHERE stage='Round of 32'
SELECT match_id, home_ft+away_ft AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home_ft+away_ft DESC) AS rnk FROM matches ORDER BY rnk, match_id
SELECT s.country, ROUND(100.0*SUM(m.went_to_extra_time=1)/COUNT(*),1) p FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id=s.stadium_id GROUP BY s.country ORDER BY p DESC, s.country
SELECT t.team_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(g.is_penalty=1)/COUNT(*),1) p FROM goals g JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=g.scoring_team_id GROUP BY t.team_id ORDER BY p DESC, t.team_name

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) n, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) r FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON g.match_id=m.match_id JOIN stadiums s ON s.stadium_id=m.stadium_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=g.scoring_team_id WHERE s.stadium_name='Atlanta Stadium' GROUP BY t.team_id ORDER BY r, t.team_name
